messages:
Alice M: Heads up — I'm seeing spikes in version_entropy for several tenants after we flipped the default v2 routing flag yesterday.
Ben S: where are you seeing it? heatmap?
Alice M: Dashboard -> Routing Signals -> Version Entropy. Example tenant acme-inc: entropy jumped from 0.02 -> 0.34 over 30m.
Carla R: 0.34 is high. Does that correlate with per-route quota throttles? could be retries.
Dylan (eng-platform): Noticed retry storms around 16:03 UTC too. Possibly client libs fell back to v1 and retried. We should check sampling window.
Alice M: Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT tenant, avg(version_entropy) as e, sum(retries) as r
FROM routing_signals
WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY tenant
ORDER BY e desc
LIMIT 20;
```
Ben S: Nice. Two proposals: 1) add a rolling window smoothing (exponential) for version_entropy to avoid transient spikes; 2) introduce a per-tenant entropy threshold that gates a console alert and an optional auto-fallback.
Carla R: For console UX, we need a compact signal: 'version-variance' with color levels and a one-click 'pin to rollout' action. Also show last trigger cause (quota, error-rate, client header mismatch).
Dylan (eng-platform): Implementation notes: smoothing is cheap. Auto-fallback is trickier — we need a kill-switch and quota-awareness so we don't cascade into more throttle-induced fallbacks.
deploy-bot: deploy started to routing-svc@canary (dylan/entropy-smoothing) — 1805553340
Alice M: good. Can we add a telemetry tag when auto-fallback happens: `fallback.reason=entropy_threshold` and `fallback.smoothing=enabled`?
Ben S: Yes. Then billing/quotas team can run postmortem on any cost shifts.
Carla R: UX mock: https://figma.redwood.in/versions/entropy-dashboard — includes heatmap, per-tenant sparklines, threshold slider. Need PO signoff.
Alice M: I'll file a console task and a runbook snippet for ops. Short-term: bump sampling window to 2m and enable smoothing in canary.
Dylan (eng-platform): I'll roll the smoothing to canary now and add metric `version_entropy_smoothed`.
Ben S: +1. followups: add alert playbook, add audit log entry for any auto-fallback.
Alice M: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
